product_from_film: Whop Treasury is presented as a way to move a balance into a yield-bearing treasury position.
explains_well: The transfer example shows amount entry, a review step, confirmation and a changed balance allocation.
unclear: The film moves from a small account transfer to a large 30-year growth illustration without clearly explaining the illustration’s assumptions.
scenario: Move USD balance into USDT Treasury and review deposit options.
product_clear_basis: The title states Whop Treasury and earn up to 6% on your balance.
